principle: 映射 ≠ 導入。閱讀 ≠ 收藏。收藏 ≠ 下載。

sources.label: Project Gutenberg
sources.contentPolicy: Do not bulk-download full text. Resolve identity and approved source only.
sources.rightsPolicy: Project Gutenberg rights statements are US-oriented; preserve source declaration and do not infer worldwide public-domain status.

sources.label: Standard Ebooks
sources.contentPolicy: Index curated editions and keep EPUB acquisition URLs remote until the user opens or adds a book.
sources.rightsPolicy: Preserve Standard Ebooks edition provenance and source rights declaration.

sources.label: 中文維基文庫
sources.contentPolicy: Index metadata and canonical page references first. Do not bulk-copy full text into 黎明書局.
sources.rightsPolicy: Preserve each work/page rights declaration and Wikisource licensing provenance. Do not infer public-domain status solely from age or presence on Wikisource.

sources.label: Wikisource WS Export
sources.contentPolicy: Use WS Export EPUB acquisition links on demand; do not store full EPUBs in the catalog.
sources.rightsPolicy: Preserve Wikisource page/source licensing and attribution provenance.

sources.label: Directory of Open Access Books
sources.contentPolicy: Index DOAB metadata and publisher/OAPEN links; download content only on explicit user reading/import action.
sources.rightsPolicy: DOAB metadata is CC0; preserve each book's individual open-access license and hosting provenance.

sources.label: Open Library
sources.contentPolicy: Do not use Open Library as the bookstore content backend. Use it for Work/Edition/ISBN/cover identity completion.
sources.rightsPolicy: Preserve provenance for all resolved identifiers and covers; reading rights come from the actual publication source.
